description: A raw object removed from the CAS by the retention sweeper (actor system:retention) because nothing on the chain cites it; a public-record object can never be expired.

claims: at the recorded position on the chain, the object at this address was uncited by any admitted spec, resolution manifest, event payload, or specAddress, and was removed
doesNotClaim: that the bytes never existed or were never read
that the recorded actor held the key whose fingerprint is recorded — admissions are not yet signed by their actors
